title: Messerschmitt's 1952 interview with a French paper

tellings.quote: Messerschmitt in '52 gives this interview to this French paper and he says, "If you see UFOs in the sky, they're probably the ones that I designed and was built by, you know, the Habermohl project and, you know, Škoda Works under Hans Kammler.

plain: The German aircraft designer Messerschmitt is said to have told a French newspaper in 1952 that if people saw UFOs in the sky, they were probably craft he had designed, built through a German flying-disc effort Michels calls the Habermohl project and at the Škoda Works, an arms plant, under the Nazi weapons chief Hans Kammler. Michels tells this himself and does not name the paper. If true, some UFO sightings would trace back to secret wartime German aircraft.
